prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry (B2B vs B2C), timeline, and the services you need (SEO, PPC, content, social, email, web design, analytics, etc.). I can help you find the best fit; to do that I’ll need more about your business. Meanwhile, here’s a practical way to find and evaluate top local agencies plus next steps.

How to pick the best agency for your situation
- Define objectives & KPIs: revenue lift, leads/month, cost-per-lead, organic traffic, ROAS, brand awareness, etc.  
- Match specialties: choose agencies that demonstrate success in your industry and for the channels you need.  
- Look for evidence: case studies, measurable results, client references, third‑party reviews (Clutch, Google, G2).  
- Evaluate process & reporting: clear onboarding, strategy cadence, dashboards, and communication frequency.  
- Team fit & availability: who will do the work vs. who sells it; capacity to take you on.  
- Pricing & contract terms: monthly retainer vs. project vs. performance, minimum terms, exit/ownership of assets.  
- Tools & transparency: which platforms and tracking they use; access to accounts and raw data.  
- Red flags: vague promises, lack of KPIs, no references, “guaranteed” rankings, or outsourced unknown teams.

Where to search for reputable St. Louis agencies
- Clutch.co and UpCity (filter by St. Louis, read verified reviews)  
- Google Maps / Google Business listings (reviews & recent posts)  
- LinkedIn (agency pages, employee profiles, local network referrals)  
- Local business publications and award lists (St. Louis Business Journal, Ad Club of St. Louis)  
- Ask peers in your industry for referrals

Helpful questions to ask prospects
- What measurable results have you delivered for clients like us? Can you share case studies and references?  
- Who will be on the account team and how much time will they spend on it?  
- What’s the proposed strategy, deliverables, timeline, and expected KPIs in 3, 6, 12 months?  
- How do you report performance and how often? Can I see a sample dashboard?  
- Which tools/platforms do you use and will we have direct access?  
- What are your fees, billing cadence, contract length, and cancellation terms?  
- How do you handle creative, landing pages, tracking and attribution?

Typical cost ranges (very general)
- Small SEO or social packages: $750–$3,000+/month  
- Full-service digital retainers: $3,000–$20,000+/month depending on scope  
- PPC management: management fee 10–20% of ad spend (with minimums) + ad budget  
- Project-based work (website, migrations): $5,000–$100,000 depending on complexity

Next steps I can take for you
- If you tell me: your industry, primary goals, monthly budget, and timelines, I’ll shortlist 3–5 St. Louis agencies that match and summarize the pros/cons of each.  
- Or I can draft a short RFP/email template you can send to agencies.

Would you like me to shortlist agencies for you? If so, tell me your main goals (e.g., generate 50 qualified leads/month), monthly budget, and whether you’re B2B or B2C.
